specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

intro_questions: What are the primary structural elements of an aircraft?
Can you list the initial steps in the aircraft design process?
What are the basic requirements for aircraft design?

development.content:
Conceptualization and preliminary design
Detailed design and analysis
Prototyping and testing phases
Manufacturing process overview
Quality control and final assembly

Aircraft design requirements and constraints

Maintenance planning and documentation
Lifecycle management and upgrades
Environmental impact considerations
Future trends in aircraft design

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between design requirements and manufacturing processes.
How do structural elements influence the overall aircraft design?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the steps in aircraft design lead to airworthiness certification requirements covered in LP 03.
